summary.short: Utah S.B. 149 creates an Office of Artificial Intelligence Policy in the Department of Commerce to run an AI learning laboratory, where approved participants may receive temporary regulatory mitigation. It also lets an actor be found guilty of an offense committed with generative AI's aid. Effective May 1, 2024.
summary.long: S.B. 149 creates the Office of Artificial Intelligence Policy in the Department of Commerce, headed by a director appointed by the executive director. The Office must create and administer an AI learning laboratory program, consult stakeholders, make rules on participation fees, criteria, data usage limits, cybersecurity and disclosures, and report annually before November 30 to the Business and Labor Interim Committee. Participants may receive temporary regulatory mitigation through agreements that limit scope (users, geography) and set safeguards; they remain subject to requirements not expressly waived and may be removed at any time. Participants must report required information, retain records, and immediately report incidents of consumer harm, privacy breach or unauthorized data usage. Initial agreements run up to 12 months, with one 12-month extension. The text also repeals Chapter 70 on May 1, 2025 and adds Section 76-2-107, under which a person may be found guilty of an offense committed with the aid of generative AI or by prompting it to commit the offense. The bill takes effect May 1, 2024.

notes: Relations and notes only. The Chapter 70 repeal on May 1, 2025 (Section 11) is a sunset date within the amended 63I-2-213, not a relation; the bill's effective date is May 1, 2024 (Section 13). Internal inconsistencies: 13-70-302(3) requires the 'applicant' to meet criteria while the subject is the 'participant'; 13-70-305(3) refers to an 'initial demonstration period' while 13-70-305(1)-(2) use 'participation period' and '12-month' terms; 13-70-101(12)(a)-(d) defines 'regulatory mitigation' with a fragmentary list. Target instrument IDs are empty because the targets are not in the registry. The relations section is populated, so the section_status entry below is a schema placeholder.
